ardot_hsip.title: Highway Safety Improvement Program Process
ardot_hsip.note: attached to ARDOT's HSIP report on FHWA's HSIP online reporting site; research_notes/ar-2026-11-08/ar-methods.md

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.page: App. E, p. E-2 (PDF p. 59), 'Adjusted Crash Cost Estimates by Crash Severity'; dollar year from p. E-3 '(Adjusted for 2020 dollars)'
rules: one comprehensive cost per KABCO level (HSM Table 4A-1 adjusted for Arkansas), every location type
ARDOT's benefit-cost work uses the KA/BC/O weighted averages on p. E-3 ($1,406,292 / $88,101 / $11,000); CrashIQ prices each crash at its own level

statewide_rates.missing: ARDOT computes statewide average crash rates by roadway type (Traffic Safety section duties) but the HSIP Process document doesn't print them, and CrashIQ has no Arkansas traffic counts

screening.state_method: Critical KA Crash Rate, ranked by Critical Index (KA rate / critical KA rate); intersections ~160 ft influence on each leg (ARDOT HSIP Process 2022, §2.2.1, pp. 10-11)

min_years.missing: ARDOT ranks on five-year crash totals (App. E, p. E-2; App. F, p. F-2) but sets no minimum study period for a corridor study

spf_calibration.missing: ARDOT calibrated six HSM SPFs and found the factors 'not useful' (HSIP Process 2022, §2.2.1, p. 11); none published
